scores.notes: Peter in his wrapped coat leaps from the boat and the disciple points, but Jesus already stands on the pebbles right beside the beached boat (right) while the pointing and the leap go left into open water away from him: poses and place contradict. Pale sky is a tinted wash to the edge; no lettering.

Dark waters with light breaking at the horizon fits the verse and shows no figure, but a row of scattered pixel/mosaic blocks runs across the upper sky (about x190-1190, y40-140) like a blocked-out line of text; I record it as glyph-like marks, unreadable. It may be a rendering artefact rather than writing.
Peter grips the lame man's right hand and raises him at the temple gate, John beside him, onlookers behind; hands and limbs read correctly, canvas painted to all edges, no lettering.
Bald Elisha in a hairy mantle on the stony road up to the town, a knot of youths by the gate pointing and jeering at him (right); no lettering, edges painted, overlapping arms all assignable.

Holmes studies the battered hat with his lens while Watson looks on by the fire: right moment. Lettering: rows of squiggle script on the loose papers on the table and tick marks on the mantel clock dial, none readable. White paper margin shows at left/right edges and top-right corner (accepted). Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.

A single large man gazing upward with scrolls and a quill at his belt reads as the letter-writer himself (the narrator of the verse) rather than anything the verse describes; village and a tiny soldier behind. Vignette with an irregular white paper margin all round (accepted). No lettering.
Aged Adam laid out dead on a mat outside the tent with family kneeling and standing in mourning; washes run to every edge, no lettering, anatomy sound.

Saul shields his eyes in a burst of light from the sky near Damascus, companions reeling: right moment. A roadside milestone right of centre is inscribed with capitals and numerals reading 'MIM / III', real readable characters. Wash breaks to bare paper at the bottom corners and left edge (accepted).

Holmes half-risen, hurling the great ball of papers up at the rack, Watson seated opposite, papers strewn on seat and floor: right moment. Lettering: newsprint drawn as lines of squiggles with picture blocks on the sheets and the ball, unreadable. White paper at the top-left corner and right edge (accepted). Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.

Disciples stand on the shore at dawn round a fire of coals with fish and loaves on it, beached boat and heaped net beside them (ten men, more than the seven of the story, minor). No lettering, edges painted, anatomy sound.
The man kneels in his house over the dead woman on a mat with the knife poised, donkey at the door; the act is implied with no blood or dismemberment shown, so no gore. No lettering, edges painted.

Aged Adam dying or dead on his bedding, an elder kneeling holding his hand, family mourning on both sides. Washes fade to bare paper at the top-left corner and along the bottom (accepted); no lettering, anatomy sound.

Priest stoops casting the crop and feathers onto the ash heap beside the horned bronze altar, tabernacle behind with an embroidered curtain (ornament, not writing); no figure for God, no lettering, edges painted.

Night courtyard with a fire: Peter in the foreground, hand to chest, looking back at the bound Jesus among guards. Jesus's head is in profile toward the fire rather than squarely at Peter, a weak rendering of the look but the moment, people and place are right. Painted to all edges, no lettering.

Saul on his knees shielding his eyes under a shaft of light from the clouds, companions and horses startled, Damascus behind (domes and minarets are anachronistic, noted only). No lettering, edges painted, anatomy sound.

A weary man in a patched robe leans on a stone pillar as a beam of light from the sky falls on him, city behind, bystanders seated at right; strength given to the weak shown without drawing God. No lettering, edges painted.

Holmes with lens offers the battered hat to Watson in the sitting room by the fire: right moment. Lettering: tick marks round the mantel clock dial, unreadable. Bare white paper at the left edge and bottom-left corner by the armchair (accepted). Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.

Empty throne in radiance and cloud under a rainbow, glassy floor before it, four creatures (lion, calf, man-faced, eagle) with eye-studded wings around it; no figure on the throne, no lettering, painted to the edges. A stray brown post beside the man-faced creature's legs is a minor oddity.

Throne dissolved in light and cloud with rainbow and a glass-like sea, four creatures with eyed wings, but the lion (left) wears a short-sleeved maroon tunic and the eagle is a robed standing humanoid, which reads comic rather than strange and fearsome. Throne seat shows only folds of light, no head or limbs. No lettering.

Saul with arm flung out and the spear in flight, David twisting away with his lyre, attendants looking on; banner at top left carries gold ornament only, no spirit figure drawn, anatomy sound, edges painted.
Egyptian chariots and horsemen charge down the dry seabed between two walls of water at night; no figure for God, no lettering, edges painted, horses and riders read correctly.

Cat's head in the air, Alice hugging her flamingo, the Queen close behind with hand to ear: right moment. But the Queen's design (huge heart-shaped red curled hair, white-painted face, blue eyeshadow, tiny lips) copies the Red Queen of the 2010 live-action film, and a full-bodied human man in a brown coat stands among the card soldiers. Lettering: playing-card pips, unreadable. Wire hoops stand beside the bent soldiers (noted only).

Railway carriage, Holmes tossing the crumpled ball of papers up to the rack, Watson seated: right moment. Lettering: newspapers all over seats and floor carry mock headlines and columns with picture blocks; zoomed, the headline glyphs are pseudo-letters, no real words. Painted to all edges. Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.

Court scene with King, Queen, White Rabbit in spectacles holding the paper, Alice, animal jury with slates and card soldiers: right moment (Knave not clearly picked out). Lettering: card pips, squiggle lines on the Rabbit's scroll and the loose papers, tick marks on his watch dial, none readable. Painted to all edges.

Daniel raises a palm refusing the gifts and points to the glowing plaster wall before the seated king at the banquet; the wall panel is left blank, tapestry patterns are ornament only, so no lettering. Anatomy sound, edges painted.

Bank vault with crates: Holmes closing the slide of the dark lantern behind a crate, Watson with revolver on a case, bulky Jones and elderly Merryweather (he stands in the open rather than hidden, minor). No lettering, no deerstalker, anatomy sound, edges painted. Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.

Daniel stands unharmed among four quiet lions in the stone pit while the king kneels at the rim with a torch; no lettering (collar is ornament). Wash thins to bare paper at the left edge and bottom corners (accepted).

A pig roots in the middle of the Israelite camp with people looking on, which shows the law's subject, but the most prominent figures are a staff-bearing elder pointing at it (Moses) and a priest in a jewelled breastplate (Aaron): the speakers of the law, whom the verse itself does not name. I lean extra figure but it is borderline, since it can be read as the teaching occasion. Smoke column over the tabernacle is not a figure; no lettering.

Disciples gathered on the pebble shore round a coal fire with fish and loaves, boat and nets at left (about thirteen men, more than the story's seven, minor). No lettering, anatomy sound, edges painted.

City-gate street with people rejoicing arms raised and coins heaped on tables, sacks and jars; Wisdom appears only as white ribbons of wind, no figure. Coins are blank, no lettering; ink and wash run to all edges.

Daniel in the den speaks up to the king at the opening while a glowing robed angel lays a hand on a lion's head and five lions rest quietly; the angel is called for by the text. No lettering, anatomy sound, edges painted.

King pale and clutching his note-book, Queen leaning in, jury with slates: right moment, but Alice is drawn at ordinary child size, no taller than the card soldiers, at the very moment the court calls her a mile high, so her size does not read. Lettering: card pips and scribble lines on the slates, unreadable. Painted to all edges.

Samuel pours the horn of oil over kneeling young David with a golden radiance falling on him, Jesse and three brothers looking on (one in armour); Spirit shown as light only. No lettering, anatomy sound, edges painted.

Giant Alice looms over the court (size reads clearly), Queen pointing, King with note-book: right moment. But a second crowned, wigged, red-robed king sits at the clerks' table bottom centre, and a third small crowned figure sits mid-crowd, so the King is drawn more than once. Lettering: card pips and pseudo-script lines on the papers at the bottom, unreadable. Painted to all edges.

Alice drinks from the little bottle beside the three-legged glass table in the long lamplit hall of doors, tiny curtained door at the end; the bottle's paper label is blank so no lettering. Edges painted, anatomy sound.

Cheshire Cat's head alone in the air, Alice looking up to talk, flamingo put down, hedgehog on the ridged lawn: right moment, but Alice holds an ordinary wooden croquet mallet in the foreground while the flamingo that is her mallet lies beside it, a contradiction of objects. Lettering: pips on the distant card soldiers, tiny and unreadable.

Alice with the flamingo tucked under her arm looking up at her, hedgehog crawling off, ridges and furrows, Queen stamping and shouting, a card soldier bent as an arch: right moment. Lettering: card pips and tiny corner squiggles, unreadable. Wooden mallets and wire hoops also lie about (noted only, background). Washes reach every edge.

Hatherley with bandaged hand points at the great white house spouting fire from every window, three horse-drawn engines on the lawn, Holmes, Watson and the station-master on the road: right moment. Lettering: columns of pseudo-print on the papers under the station-master's arm, unreadable. Both of Hatherley's hands are bandaged (minor). Painted to all edges. Face-to-actor likeness not assessed (I do not identify real people from faces); rule answer rests on costume and props.
Jesus stands in the boat with hand stretched over a flat calm lake as the storm clouds part, disciples gazing up at him; no lettering, anatomy sound, edges painted.
Aged Adam lies dead on a reed mat with family kneeling and standing in mourning, huts and a hide tent behind; no lettering, hands and limbs read correctly, edges painted.

A long column of Israelites with sheep and bundles walks the wet seabed between two towering walls of water, staff-bearing elder at front right; no figure for God, no lettering. Wash breaks to bare paper along the bottom edge and bottom-right corner (accepted).
